style: Hand-drawn digital illustration, thick clean black outlines, detailed painterly backgrounds, moody cinematic lighting, dark warm palette with a single lime-green accent light, vertical 9:16, empty space at the top and bottom, no text anywhere.
avoid: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, extra limbs, glowing outlines, plain white background, flat vector look.
people: Any other person is a simple cartoon figure with a round plain white head and a minimal face.

shots.p: Wide shot, eye level: The character shakes hands with a smiling agency salesman in a blazer across a glossy glass conference table in a modern office at night, a signed contract and a pen between them, lime-green light from a laptop.
Close-up shot, high angle: a pen resting on a blank signed contract on a dark polished desk, a lime-green desk lamp light, nothing printed on the paper.
Medium shot, low angle: The character walks out of a glass office building at night into the street, folder under one arm, looking worried, lime-green streetlight and wet pavement reflections.

Medium shot, eye level: The character at a meeting table throws crumpled sticky notes of ideas at an agency salesman, who calmly counts coins on a calculator, a huge pile of paper notes growing on the table, lime-green lamp light.

Wide shot, slightly high angle: an empty chair on one side of a meeting table while three agency developers with round plain white heads assemble a lopsided strange machine from a sheet of instructions, dim office, lime-green light from a monitor.

Medium shot, over the shoulder: The character stares at an enormous monitor polishing one tiny detail late at night, a pile of coffee cups on the desk, a wall clock with no numbers on the wall behind, lime-green screen glow.

Medium shot, eye level: The character slides a single sheet of paper across a table to an agency salesman who nods enthusiastically with a huge grin and a thumbs up, warm lamp light and a faint lime-green glow from a laptop.
Close-up shot, eye level: an agency salesman with a round plain white head and a too-wide eager grin rubbing his hands together, lime-green rim of light on the table.
Close-up shot, eye level: The character's face lit from below by a laptop, sweat drop on the forehead, wide worried eyes, dark room, lime-green screen glow.

Wide shot, eye level: The character sits at a small kitchen table in a dim apartment at night, hand hovering over the laptop trackpad, a phone lit up beside it, hesitating, lime-green laptop glow and a pink-free warm lamp.

Wide shot, slightly high angle: The character stands in a glass-walled startup office at night with arms crossed, behind him twelve identical engineers with round plain white heads typing at long rows of desks, city lights outside, lime-green light on the monitors.
Close-up shot, eye level: The character smirks confidently, arms crossed, in front of a glowing wall of blank monitors in a dark office, lime-green monitor light on his face.

Medium shot, low angle: The character stands at a glass wall with arms spread triumphantly, behind him engineers with round plain white heads high-fiving in front of a wall of blank monitors, lime-green light.

Wide shot, eye level: The character sits at a small kitchen table at night in a dim apartment, an open laptop in front of him casting lime-green light, a blank paper price tag hanging from the laptop screen like a shop tag, nothing printed on it.
Close-up shot, high angle: a blank glowing lime-green button on a laptop screen at night, dark room, no text on the button.

Wide shot, eye level: a crowd of strangers with round plain white heads and blank faces standing on a night city street, all looking at their phones with arms crossed and skeptical postures, lime-green light from a shop window.

Medium shot, eye level: A freelance developer with a round plain white head and headphones packs a laptop into a backpack and heads for the apartment door while the character watches from the kitchen table, warm lamp light and a faint lime-green laptop glow.

Medium shot, high angle: The character holds up a phone as hundreds of tiny blank hearts shower down around him, an open empty wallet lying on the table beside the phone, lime-green phone light, dark apartment.

Medium shot, eye level: The character sits on a worn sofa between three friends with round plain white heads who all smile politely with thumbs up, hands kept in their laps, nobody holding a credit card, warm lamp light, a faint lime-green laptop glow.

Medium shot, low angle: The character stands on a night street holding out a small card reader toward a tall intimidating stranger with a round plain white head and folded arms, sweat drop, lime-green neon from a shop sign without text.

Medium shot, over the shoulder: The character types at a laptop showing a simple blank one-page website with a lime-green glow, a mug of coffee and a desk lamp, apartment at night, focused expression.
Wide shot, slightly low angle: dozens of white paper airplanes flying out of a glowing open laptop on a rooftop edge toward a city skyline at night, lime-green glow from the laptop, painterly clouds.

Medium shot, eye level: The character sits on a sofa looking at a phone with a small surprised grin, three glowing blank notification bubbles floating above the phone, warm lamp light, lime-green phone glow.

Medium shot, eye level: The character sits at a laptop in a glass office at night holding up a credit card with a sly look, an open browser page on the blank screen, lime-green screen glow on his face.

Wide shot, eye level: The character sits at a small kitchen table late at night looking at a glowing laptop, a bowl of cereal untouched beside it, lime-green laptop light, dim apartment, shocked posture.
Close-up shot, eye level: The character's face lit from below by a laptop, eyes wide, mouth slightly open in disbelief, dark room, lime-green screen glow.
